_comment: Neutral model catalog. role: stt-browser | stt-server | tts. 'source' is an HF repo id or URL; weights are DOWNLOADED on demand, never shipped in the repo. Sizes are approximate.

models.name: Whisper base (in-browser WASM)
models.runtime: transformers.js (WASM/WebGPU, runs in the browser tab)
models.notes: Fully offline in the browser. No bridge needed for STT. Best for privacy + simple setup; lower accuracy than server mlx.

models.name: Whisper tiny (in-browser WASM)
models.notes: Fastest, smallest, lowest accuracy. Good for weak hardware.

models.name: mlx-whisper large-v3-turbo (server, Apple Silicon)
models.runtime: mlx-whisper on the bridge (MPS). Browser streams audio to the bridge /stt endpoint.
models.notes: Default STT in Eon's existing voice-loop. Most accurate; requires the bridge + Apple Silicon. Apple Silicon only; on Windows/Linux use in-browser Whisper.

models.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B (server, English-only)
models.license: CC-BY-4.0 (NVIDIA Parakeet weights) — attribution required; parakeet-mlx Apache-2.0
models.notes: English only. Very fast on Apple Silicon. Verify the weight repo's license tag before redistribution; attribution required, NOT bundled. Apple Silicon only; on Windows/Linux use in-browser Whisper.

models.name: Kokoro-82M (TTS)
models.license: Apache-2.0 (weights). Runtime pulls misaki (Apache-2.0) + espeak-ng (GPL-3.0, system/loader binary).
models.notes: Matches Eon's voice-loop (voice af_heart, lang_code a, 24kHz). Voices are small .pt files downloaded per voice.
